status: fixed before support measurement; acceptance depends on Stage 6 gates
task: Retrospective listen-time reconstruction using the pinned dump and current recording metadata; not an as-of deployment replay

cohort.rule: SHA256 of seed + ':' + positive decimal listener ID; first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian modulo 10 equals 0
cohort.scope: Keep all retained listeners' valid events within the entire interval; no per-listener truncation

recording_identity: Use normalized recording MBIDs as distinct identifiers. No undocumented merge of same-title versions or acoustically unverified candidates.

training.binary_pairs: Unique listener-recording pairs from train only
training.candidate_catalog: Recordings with at least 5 distinct training listeners
training.qualifying_neighbor: A different candidate recording with at least 3 shared distinct training listeners
training.panel_gate: At least 32 of the unchanged 40 titles resolve to a candidate with at least 3 qualifying neighbors. Unresolved entries remain in the denominator. Report ability to return 10 separately.

queries.unit: One query per listener per holdout window
queries.seed: First valid event at window start <= t < window start + 21 days; equal-time ties choose lexicographically smallest recording MBID, independent of support or future targets
queries.targets: Distinct other recordings with seed time < t < seed time + 7 days and t < window end; equal-time and exactly-seven-day events are excluded
queries.scorable: Seed is in the fixed train candidate catalog and at least one target is in that catalog
queries.unsupported: Do not replace unsupported first seeds with later supported seeds
queries.denominators: Report all active listeners, constructed queries, listeners without an early seed, unsupported seeds, zero targets, all-out-of-catalog targets, target-pair catalog coverage, scorable count/share and distinct scorable seeds
queries.gate_per_window: At least 500 scorable queries and 100 distinct scorable seeds
queries.ranking_universe: Every item in the same fixed training catalog except the seed; no sampled negatives or history-based candidate removal

stage_7_boundary: Stage 6 reports data support and query feasibility only. No ranking quality, shrinkage choice or measured improvement is produced. Tune only on validation after data acceptance; keep test for the frozen final model comparison.
